meta.title: Compare Tano With Creator Marketing Alternatives | Tano
meta.description: Compare Tano with ShopMy, LTK, Agentio and GRIN: how each one runs creator marketing, for brands weighing up how to run their own creator programme.

hero.title: Compare Tano with the alternatives
paragraphs: These pages are written for brands weighing up how to run creator marketing.

items.title: ShopMy vs Tano: creator discovery for today, or a programme that compounds over time?
items.body: ShopMy and Tano can both help a brand work with creators, drive affiliate sales and get product into the hands of people with influence. But they are built for different creator operating models.

items.title: LTK vs Tano: marketplace reach, or a creator programme that compounds on your site?
items.body: LTK and Tano both help brands generate sales through creators, but they are built for different jobs. LTK is a shopping marketplace with a consumer app. Tano is the operating layer for a creator programme that belongs to your brand. Plenty of brands run both.

items.title: Agentio vs Tano: buy creator placements, or build a creator programme?
items.body: Both make creator marketing programmatic, but they automate different things. Agentio automates the media buy: you set a budget and it matches you with creators whose content runs as ads. Tano automates the programme: finding, briefing, paying and re-engaging creators who stay with your brand. So the real question is what you are buying: a placement or a relationship.

items.title: GRIN vs Tano: software you run, or a programme run for you?
items.body: GRIN is creator marketing software that a brand's own team runs. Tano is a creator advertising platform: it pairs specialist AI agents with a senior in-house team to run an always-on creator programme for a brand.

closing.title: See if Tano fits your programme.
closing.body: Share where your creator programme is today. Our strategists will come back with what it would take to run it always-on, with the relationships and content rights staying with your brand.
